notes.title: The Tales of Bayun — demo update, event results and new information
notes.content:
While other people try to disguise themselves into vampires, witches and other supernatural creatures, our team works our  tail off with The Tales of Bayun. And we have some information to share!

First of all, we’ve once again updated the demo: added a new map, descriptions, dialogue lines and even several dialogue branches, updated animations, visual effects and fixed some bugs. 

Secondly, we have finally summarized the Streamers and Video-makers event. This time the winner is Anna Shepard, congratulations! We’ve also decided to honor DamRiele, Victoria Engine and GamerDotCom for their previous videos, thank you for such amazing content. All mentioned creators will receive The Tales of Bayun Steam key at the time of the full release.

Thirdly, we decided to keep the Streamers initiative going. From time to time we will browse related YouTube videos and award the most appealing to our team authors with free game keys. Perhaps, one of those will be given to you!

Finally, we are ready to pull back the curtain on The Tales of Bayun second episode. Here is the very first screenshot! Do you have any suggestions about the plot or the characters? Feel free to discuss them! We will share even more information later on, but as for now — have a great Halloween! 


https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1007389855795380386/1036639032110759946/The_Tales_of_Bayun_2_edited.png
